apps/console/src/perf/coverage.test.ts::a budget line no page measures fails
apps/console/src/perf/coverage.test.ts::a measured name with no line fails
apps/console/src/perf/coverage.test.ts::a registry key that is not a page, or a page with no entry, fails

guard_cases: the six existing pages' dom/rpc lines after moving into PERF_PAGES: same counts as before (onair.l1 240, characters.l1 495, brain.l1 137, segments.l1 143, simulator.l1 55, reconcile.l1 213, l2 lists 296/639/318/179/336/343/806); green before and after by design
deviations_from_card: Probe gained optional before() (reconcile.l2 seeds session.showReport), timeout, and l1.rpcScript (simulator's RPC count runs on simGrid, the DOM count on sim10x, as before). Probe.ui/script are thunks. rpc orphan message is '<name>: rpc budgeted but no page measures it'. Case 2 is kept permanently as a @ts-expect-error in coverage.test.ts. Case 5 asserts 2,000-row count <= 200-row count (502 vs 524: the row content differs, the window does not grow). Tests and implementation are one commit: the tests import pages.tsx and cannot load without it. Stale citations corrected: rpc.test.tsx was 63 lines (hand list at 39-62, not 318-342), timings at 52-82 (not 343-364), fixture scripts at 42-162, harness overBudget at 114-119, line() at 41-45, perf.json dom 4-18/rpc 19-26 at a587a25.
notes: Finding: review.l2.timeline measures 6,331 nodes on a 60-min 100k-event session (line 6,840) - ~8x any other layer-2 line. 60 min at 30 s rows = 120 rows = VIRTUAL_AFTER (Timeline.tsx:20), so the list does not virtualise and each row carries up to DOT_CAP 40 dots; the count follows rows, not events (10k/60min 6,235; 100k/30min 3,211). Lowering VIRTUAL_AFTER is the lever (production code, out of this card's write set) - worth a follow-up card. Seeded violations: removing dom review.l1 from perf.json -> coverage test red ('review.l1: measured but no line in budgets/perf.json'); renaming review out of PERF_PAGES -> typecheck red. First `test -- src/perf` run (which runs the whole suite) had one red in src/shell/goto.dom.test.tsx (timing flake under load, not mine); re-run and the full suite were green.
